Counsel for the Petitioner: Sri. Jeshtadi Sunil Kumar Counsel for the Respondent:

PUBLIC PROSECUTOR Petition under Section 430(1) of BNSS., is filed praying that in the circumstances stated in the grounds filed in support of the petition, the High Court may be pleased to suspend the execution of sentence vide Judgment 22.11.2024 in POCSO Sessions Case No. 12/2021 on the file of the Court of Special Judge for Speedy Trial of Offences Under POCSO Act, Nellore for the offences under Sec. 363, 376(3) of IPC and Sec. 3(a) r/w. 4 of POCSO Act, 2012 and release the Appellant on Bail pending disposal of the Criminal Appeal The court while directing issue of notice to the Respondents herein to show cause as to why this application should not be complied with, made the following order.(The receipt of this order will be deemed to be the receipt of notice in the case).

r M The Court made the following ORDER:
Heard Sri Jeshtadi Sunil Kumar, learned counsel for the petitioner.

Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that the petitioner is suffering from serious health issues and he is taking treatment in the jail hospital, thereby seeking bail for a period of two months on medical grounds.
Learned counsel for the petitioner placed on record the medical report of the petitioner.

sentences.text: Learned Assistant Public Prosecutor, on written instructions, would submit that the petitioner is suffering from health issues.
Now his condition is stable.
But he is taking treatment in the Jail hospital.

For ready reference, the instructions submitted by the learned Assistant Public Prosecutor are extracted hereunder:
"

This is to certify that a convict Prisoner named by P. Subbarayudu S/0 Rosalah,
aged about 63 years, Male CT NO: 7554 was admitted Into Central Prison Nellore on 22-11-2024.
At the time of admission, he was examined by the Jail medical officer and found he is a know case of Diabetic Mellitus and hypertension and old CVA (Cerebral Vascular Artery Disease) on treatment.
On 04-01-2025 He came to Jail hospital with complainant of low backache given treatment symptomatically.
On 05-01-2025 he was referred to G.G.H Nellore the G.G.H Medical authorities examined and diagnosed sciatica and they are advised investigations and advised to review later.
He was reviewed on 09-01-2025, 28-02-2025 to the G.G.H Nellore Orthopedic department they advised investigations and started treatment.
He came to Jail hospital on 11-03-2025 with complaint of left side face muscle weakness and numbness and given treatment symptomatically.
On 12-03-2025 he was referred to G.G.H Nellore they are diagnosed left side bells palsy and started treatment.
f At present getting treatment as per advised of G.G.H Nellore authorities.
He is getting Physiotherapy alternate day in jail Hospital form 14-03-2025 every alternate day.
Now his condition is fair and at present he is in jail Hospital and getting require treatment".

In the light of the health condition of the petitioner, it is apposite to release the petitioner on interim bail till 18.06.2025, on the following conditions:
(1) The petitioner shall execute a personal bond for Rs.20,000/-
(Rupees twenty thousand only) to the satisfaction of Superintendent, Central Prison, Nellore.
(2) The petitioner shall report before the Superintendent, Central n Prison, Nellore by 5.00p.m. on 18.06.2025.

SDZ-N.NAG   A;
